properties.decision: A new Decision status, `contested`: a question kept open on purpose, both sides on the record, no verdict owed. The nodes of the dispute are GOVERNED_BY it. Like `deferred`, it is the owner's word, carries an approver, and is not debt: it settles intent, so loop_status and what_next do not count it as owed. detect_defects does not report a contradiction between two nodes it governs and counts them in swept.suppressed_by_held_open instead. Its own truth reads unknown, never guessed.
properties.name: "Contested, by design" is said with a Decision set to `contested` that governs both sides of the dispute
properties.rationale: Anthony chose "Decision status" on 2026-10-16, at the start of requirement A. Part 3 of the requirement: an argument for and against may keep both sides with no verdict, and the counts must not read that as unfinished work. Holding a question open is itself a decision, so it should carry who decided and why, which a Decision already does. The `deferred` precedent (2026-09-12) says a status earns its place when something reads it; three things read this one: the contradiction defect, the settle rule and the truth reading. Not chosen: a flag on the objection link, which is one write but carries no rationale and no approver. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
